answer: Require every new identity to pass a live uniqueness check tied to a government eID, verified once and stored only as a salted hash. An honest agent completes it in minutes at no recurring cost. An attacker creating thousands of fakes must obtain thousands of distinct real eIDs, which means buying stolen documents and risking criminal liability for each one. A repeated signal from the same hash exposes duplicates, like identical trees planted in a grove, and clustered accounts in an orchard pattern are suspended together.
